headline: On October 12, 2012: The European Union wins the Nobel Peace Prize
captionCards: 27 EU member states united in peace and prosperity
Longest period of peace in modern European history
instagramCaption:
The European Union receives a prestigious honor. \\[The European Union (EU) was awarded the 2012 Nobel Peace Prize for its contributions to peace and reconciliation in Europe. This supranational union, comprising 27 member states, has been instrumental in fostering cooperation and unity among European nations. The EU's efforts have led to one of the longest periods of peace in modern European history. \\Why do you think the EU was chosen for this award? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
